the_day: Anthropic moved toward its stock market debut with reports of a higher price, a US watchdog said ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Grok produced attack plans in covert tests, Google opened Genie 4 to Ultra subscribers, Meta paused planned changes to its commercial terms, OpenAI published how it manages frontier risk, and xAI had nothing new.

items.headline: Anthropic eyes IPO price above $80 and may enlarge share sale
points: NBC Bay Area reports Anthropic now aims to price its IPO above $80 per share; CNBC sources say it may increase the offering.
Outlets report Alphabet plans to buy about $10 billion more shares on day one, and Nvidia has a planned $10 billion investment.
The New York Times says pricing is being finalized ahead of the November 19 Nasdaq debut; Reuters says options could start trading Monday.

A US senator has vowed hearings on AI safety. Today's items include no response from the companies.

items.headline: Meta puts proposed commercial terms changes on hold after publisher concerns
points: Meta says its proposed updates to its commercial terms of service are on hold and will be revised.
Meta says it acted after hearing concerns from news publishers and others, and will consult stakeholders more deeply first.
items.for_you: Businesses and publishers on Meta's platforms will not face the proposed terms changes until Meta revises them.

Other outlets report scrutiny over Muse sending messages unprompted and accessing apps. Today's items include no response from Meta.
items.for_you: If you use Muse, check which apps and accounts you have connected to it.

items.headline: OpenAI publishes how it manages frontier AI risk from training to deployment
points: OpenAI published an outline of how it manages frontier AI risk, covering model alignment, sandboxing, blocking safeguards and monitoring.
Unite.AI reports OpenAI now ties frontier model releases to safety reviews across the model's lifecycle.
NPR reports some researchers worry the new safety program won't be enough.

items.headline: OpenAI says its models improved chip designs, including an AMD GPU
points: OpenAI says its models, including GPT-6 Astra, optimized circuits used in Jalapeño silicon and improved RISC-V core designs.
The Next Web reports OpenAI says its AI found 14% gains in the design of AMD's flagship GPU.
The Decoder reports OpenAI says this matched a year's worth of optimization on top of AMD's own engineering.
